_comment: Expected answers from PHP's own version_compare(), generated 2026-08-30 on PHP 8.5.9. WordPress uses version_compare, so this is the oracle for scripts/lib/vercmp.py. Frozen as a fixture so the check runs everywhere, including runners with no PHP. Regenerate with test/regen-vercmp-fixture.py if the pair list ever needs to grow.
source: all pairs of 25 hand-picked edge cases, plus 2000 random pairs drawn from the 534 distinct readable versions in history/components.jsonl
